description: The plot illustrates the training loss of various models over a range of steps, comparing their performance. The x-axis is labeled "Step" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 440k, with tick labels at intervals of 20k up to 80k and then specific labels at 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled "Train Loss" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.85, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. The plot displays six lines representing different models: ChemBART Small 20M (red, solid), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue, solid), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green, solid), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange, solid), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple, solid), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown, solid). All lines start at a high train loss around 0.8, decrease sharply to approximately 0.3 by 20k steps, and then continue to decrease gradually until around 60k steps, after which they level off or slightly increase, with ChemBERTa Small 20M showing the highest train loss and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M showing one of the lowest train losses throughout the range, with values ranging from approximately 0.3 to 0.55 at 440k steps.
